what_is.subtitle: The Efficiency Map
what_is.body: Syncro is a spatiotemporal efficiency matrix based on the directional logic of the I Ching and the Five Elements framework. By analyzing the energetic alignment between your personal profile and an upcoming task, Syncro charts a comprehensive efficiency map for the next 24 hours. home.faq_q1: What if I don't know the other person's birth time?
home.faq_a1: You can still run a Match with approximate time — accuracy is slightly reduced but the core analysis remains valuable. We use 2-hour windows (Chinese hour periods), so even a rough estimate works.
home.faq_q2: Does the other person need to consent or know?
home.faq_a2: Match is for your understanding. The other person doesn't need to be involved. We never contact them, share their data, or reveal that you ran the reading. Their chart stays on your device only.
home.faq_q3: Can I do more than two people at once?
home.faq_a3: Currently Match focuses on two-person dynamics — this keeps the reading deep and clear. For complex situations (e.g., you + spouse + parent), we suggest running separate Matches to map each relationship cleanly.
home.faq_q4: How is this different from POJU?
home.faq_a4: Pivot is a 30-day deep conversation about your situation. Match is a one-time, focused two-chart reading about a specific relationship. Different tools for different needs — many users use both.
home.not_footer: Match offers insight and perspective. What you do with them is entirely yours.
